text:
Maya Patel: heads-up — saw preview counts from the wrong org when rapidly switching workspaces. Repro: open org-A, open preview panel, quick-switch to org-B, preview shows org-A rows for ~2s. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/snap/preview-leak.png
Samir Khan: can repro locally. logs show cache hits tied to a global key instead of org-scoped key. cacheKey: preview:v2:global:abcdef -> hit while headers show x-org-id=org-b
Leo Zhang: dumping relevant logs:
```
INFO 2024-11-23T14:02:03Z prefetch req id=xyz headers={x-org-id: org-b, cookie: ...}
DEBUG 2024-11-23T14:02:03Z lookup cacheKey=preview:v2:org-a:abcdef -> HIT
```
That implies the worker used a stale org in the cache lookup.
Anya Ortiz: this also affects quotas/telemetry — we saw quota spikes attributed to org-a when org-b users switch quickly. Billing/alerts may be wrong.
Samir Khan: quick hypothesis: prefetch orchestration spawns async job that closes over req.ctx.org (mutable) and if a workspace-change happens we get a window where the wrong org is used. race in workspace-change -> prefetch.
Maya Patel: immediate mitigation idea: make cache lookups validate x-org-id header against the org encoded in the cacheKey; refuse global reads if header mismatch.
Tina Gomez: agree. Also telemetry emits currently read req.ctx.org at emit-time; if ctx gets mutated we misattribute events. We should capture immutable orgId at request start and pass it explicitly to async tasks.
release-bot: rollout/eng-platform-preview-canary succeeded for svc-console v2.3.1 :rocket:
Leo Zhang: quick patch outline (will open PR):
```
// atomic key built from start-of-request org id
const orgId = req.captureOrg()
const cacheKey = `preview:${env}:${orgId}:${hash}`
if (req.headers['x-org-id'] && req.headers['x-org-id'] !== orgId) {
  // audit and avoid global cache reads
  logger.warn('org-header-mismatch', { expected: orgId, got: req.headers['x-org-id'] })
}
```
This forces org-scoped lookups and guards against cross-org reads.
Anya Ortiz: we also need a telemetry backfill plan to correct misattributed counts for the last 24h. I'll draft an aggregation job to reconcile previews by tracing request ids and reassigning counts where trace shows header/org mismatch.
Samir Khan: I can run an infra job to scan trace index and produce a reassign list; will need write perms to billing-aggregates and guidance on SLA for the backfill.
Maya Patel: owners: Samir -> infra job, Leo -> patch + PR, Anya -> telemetry backfill plan, Tina -> SRE review + postmortem draft. Please drop PR link and job run plan here. If anyone sees customer-facing impact escalate to incidents channel. :thumbsup:
